home_text: West Glamorgan City are in solid home form with 2 wins and 3 draws unbeaten, showing strong defensive efficiency by conceding fewer than expected. However, their finishing has underperformed xG, with several draws feeling harsh due to wasteful finishing despite creating good chances against mostly mid-tier opposition.
away_text: West Glamorgan City have shown mixed away form with 1 win, 2 draws, and 2 losses, underperforming their expected goals by nearly 3 scored while conceding close to their xG. Their only away win was deserved, but overall they have been wasteful in attack and defensively vulnerable in recent matches.
combined_recent_5_text: West Glamorgan City are in strong recent form with 3 wins and 2 draws unbeaten, showing clinical finishing that outperforms their xG across mostly mid-to-high tier opposition. Their only caveat is a couple of fair draws marked by missed chances, but overall their results well reflect solid performances.
